sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed 
 every six months as indicated by M6 in the above title block.

المسودة الأولى بدأها المهندس. 
Magdy El-tantawy 
 & eng. Nora El-Batrawy, 
 reviewed by eng. 
Ramadan Helmy and revised by eng. 
Abd El-Menem Al Emam EDEPC quality control, accepted by eng. 
Ali Abd El-Whab general 
 director and approved by eng. 
 Fathy Ragab 
 رئيس قطاع 
Talkha Power Station 2x210MW

هذا 
 الوثيقة مقبولة من قبل المهندس. سمير عبد الجليل: منسق EDEPC MPIS و 
 مدير عام التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة ومعتمد من المحاسب 
 محمود محمد سليمان EDEPC مسؤل. والتفتيش المالي والجودة 
 مدير عام الرقابة ومشرف التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة 
 قطاع الرأس.
احتياطات السلامة

A work permit must be issued and qualified 
 maintenance stuff should carry the suitable safety category.

سياج أمان مع علامات تحذير 
 مطلوب المحيطة بمنطقة العمل.
ارتدِ معدات السلامة والصحة الخاصة بك مثل خوذة الأمان، وأحذية السلامة، ... إلخ.
يجب أن تكون الغلاية خارج الخدمة.

Don't allow to any material of fluids 
 could 
 cause a fire in the work area.

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه

Change burner mode to local control, Check the 
 initial state of action elements in the local control box (MOS), open the MOS 
 cover and check the signal panel by means of lamp test push button.

If some of the signal lamps is off, the 
 respective signal lamp should be replaced.

If any of the signal lamps is 
 ON, the fault 
 must be removed.

The signal lamps of the action elements are 
 connected to the position-end switches which are in most cases a reason why 
 the respective signal lamps are not activated.

Cut the voltage from the cables to the igniter 
 and the disconnection of cables on the igniter should be performed by a 
 worker well acquainted with electric installation.

The igniter is not subject to complete 
 disassembling normally, but only in the case of damaged insulators, when 
 replacing the ignition plugs or if insulation condition of the igniter is 
 damaged and it is required to clean and dry it.

Check ignition transformer:
 - Test the winding resistance.
 - اختبار مقاومة العزل.
 - اختبار لون وشكل الشرارة.

The sensor for flame detection forms Sylvania 
 P 679 photoelectric cell using ultra-violet part of spectrum emitted by the 
 flame service life maximum 8000 operational hours and replacement after this 
 time.

The sensor consists primarily in cleaning the 
 glass of the photoelectric cell, The requirement of maintaining the cables and 
 contacts of the electric parts of sensor

Check the card LID-13: 
 (Emission flame detector of the ignition burner)

Check the card LUV-14: 
 (Ultra-violet flame detector of the load burner)

Check the electromagnetic device
 (Solenoid-operated valves)

اختبار التسرب الداخلي، التحقق من حالة 
 إنه مفتوح بالكامل.

Cleaning or replacing the filter on the 
 control air line.

The forced-feed lubricator dismantled once a 
 half year at least, clean thoroughly ,check periodically and add the oil level 
 , discharge impurities deposited at the container bottom.

sections.text: إعادة الموقد إلى الخدمة
Close the MOS cover.

Return the burner components (igniter, sensor, 
 solenoid valves, filter etc) to initial state.

قم بتوصيل كافة مصادر الطاقة للتحكم 
 نظام الموقد.
Keep the working area clean.
تغيير وضع الموقد إلى جهاز التحكم عن بعد.
